# Delegation Receipt Protocol vectors (third-party test fixtures)

`positive/` and `negative/` are copied unchanged from
[Commonguy25/authproof-sdk](https://github.com/Commonguy25/authproof-sdk), `vectors/`, at commit
`5047798` (default branch `main`, 10 October 2026). They are the reference SDK's published conformance vectors for
draft-nelson-agent-delegation-receipts.

Copyright (c) 2026 AuthProof. MIT License; the licence text is in `LICENSE` here.

They are used to test AMEP's DRP profile against the vectors' own expected outcomes.
